description: First-step messaging plugin use and chat-first sign-in from ordinary per-turn memory recall.

evals.name: teams-message-recalls-signed-out-plugin
evals.prompt:
Per-turn recall supplied:
Found similar in mem:
- skill_plugin_teams_client: Teams Client: not signed in. Offer sign-in: `domios plugin teams-client login`.

User: Look, Anna Ivanova wrote to me in Teams, check the PRs.

Explain your immediate next step without executing commands.
evals.expected_output: Offers Teams sign-in in chat and identifies the recalled login command as the next action.
expectations: Offers to help the user sign in to Teams in this chat instead of giving up because Teams is disconnected
Identifies domios plugin teams-client login as the next command for sign-in
Does not invent a sign-in code, a Teams message, or pull request findings

evals.name: telegram-message-recalls-connected-plugin
evals.prompt:
Per-turn recall supplied:
Found similar in mem:
- skill_plugin_telegram_client: Telegram Client: signed in. `domios plugin telegram-client --help`.

User: Anna wrote to me in Telegram about the PRs; check what she said.

Explain your immediate next step without executing commands.
evals.expected_output: Uses the recalled connected Telegram plugin to discover its chat lookup and reading verbs.
expectations: Identifies the telegram-client plugin or domios plugin telegram-client --help as the immediate tool for reading the message
Does not ask the user to connect or sign in to Telegram, because the recalled plugin is signed in
Does not claim to have read a message or checked a pull request

evals.name: missing-client-refusal-offers-chat-first-sign-in
evals.prompt:
User asked you to check Anna's Teams message. The plugin command refused with:
not-installed: helper missing
Next: `domios plugin teams-client login`. Offer chat-first sign-in; show the returned sign-in code or QR and instructions to the user in chat. Setup requirements: `domios plugin get teams-client`.

Explain your immediate next step without executing commands.
evals.expected_output: Offers the actionable login path and explains that its returned code will be shown in chat.
expectations: Offers chat-first Teams sign-in using domios plugin teams-client login
Says it will show the returned sign-in code and instructions to the user in chat
Does not give up, fabricate a sign-in code, or claim Teams was connected
